# Asset Manifest

Generated on 2026-06-23 for the AI Starter Skill Pack website and GitHub README.

These files are public repo assets, not npm package payload. `package.json` intentionally ships only `skills/` and `shared/` so installing the repo as a package stays focused on the usable skill pack.

## Files

| File | Size | Dimensions | Use |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `ai-starter-skill-pack-hero.png` | 1,638,173 bytes | 1672 x 941 | Website hero, landing-page masthead, wide README banner |
| `ai-starter-skill-pack-social.png` | 1,388,855 bytes | 1731 x 909 | README preview, Open Graph/social card, install/package section |

## Prompt: Hero

```text
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: website hero and GitHub README banner for an open-source Agent Skills pack
Primary request: Create a polished wide banner illustration for "AI Starter Skill Pack" without rendering any text. The image should communicate beginner-friendly AI learning, five small modular skill cards, practical checklists, and a calm path from confusion to useful proof.
Scene/backdrop: clean modern desk/workspace blended with a lightweight abstract interface grid; not a busy dashboard.
Subject: five distinct modular cards or tiles representing onboarding, prompt debugging, tutoring, project ideas, and career proof; subtle connectors between them; a small notebook/checklist motif.
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D illustration mixed with soft product-marketing realism; crisp enough for GitHub README and website hero use.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, central composition with generous negative space along the top and left for overlaid text in the website; no cropped important objects.
Lighting/mood: bright, optimistic, calm, practical, warm studio light.
Color palette: balanced palette with fresh green, sky blue, coral, graphite, and off-white; avoid dominant purple gradients, beige-only palettes, and dark slate monotone.
Materials/textures: matte paper cards, subtle glass interface panels, soft shadows, gentle depth.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers, no fake UI copy.
Constraints: no logos, no watermarks, no brand marks, no humans, no readable text, no clutter.
```

## Prompt: Social/Package

```text
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: README/Open Graph card and website social preview for an open-source Agent Skills repository
Primary request: Create a clean 1200x630-style social preview image for an AI skill pack. It should show a compact kit of five installable skill folders represented as neat colorful blocks/cards, with a simple package/install motif and a GitHub-ready open-source feel. Do not render any text.
Scene/backdrop: bright off-white background with subtle grid lines and a few small interface accents.
Subject: five folder-like skill blocks arranged in a tidy arc or stack, a small package box, a checkmark token, and lightweight connector lines suggesting reusable skills.
Style/medium: crisp 3D product illustration, polished but not corporate-generic, friendly to beginners.
Composition/framing: wide social-card composition, centered subject, good margins, works when cropped in README and social previews.
Lighting/mood: clean, confident, helpful, practical.
Color palette: fresh green, sky blue, coral, white, charcoal accents; balanced multi-color, no dominant purple/blue gradient.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers, no fake words.
Constraints: no logos, no GitHub mark, no watermarks, no humans, no readable UI text, no dense clutter.
```
